title: telemetry.raw v1
description: Envelope for one OTLP batch on the telemetry.raw topic. The payload stays OTLP-native and opaque to the bus; the envelope adds tenancy and provenance. tenant_id is stamped by the ingest service from the authenticated key and is never read from the payload.

tenant_id.description: Tenant slug, e.g. retail-shop | ember | khukuri

encoding.description: Wire encoding of the OTLP payload. The ingest service accepts 'json' today; 'protobuf' is reserved and currently rejected at the receiver with 415.

ingest_key_id.description: Identifier (not the secret) of the ingest key that authenticated this batch

payload.description: The raw OTLP request body, base64-encoded, in the encoding named above
